title: Bank page: Unlink/Change fails with 'account not found' for accounts in a non-active budget
notes:
Cause: bank page sent the active budget id on PATCH /accounts/:id; accounts fed by a (per-user) connection can live in another budget -> 404. Fix ea58cba on tk/budget-jda: summary returns budgetId per account, page uses it for Unlink and Change. Checks: tsc + eslint clean in all packages; client 1070 pass; shared 45 pass; api connections/catalog-outputs/access 333 pass (compose Postgres :55432). Not verified against production data.
Follow-up commit: regression test api/src/connections/cross-budget-link.test.ts (3 tests) + unlink/move require the account's budget. Full suites: api 901 pass, client 1070 pass, shared 45 pass; tsc + eslint clean.
